name: sdd
description: Spec-driven engineering plugins for Claude Code: a PR gate and the self-review workflow that feeds it.

plugins.name: sdd-gate
plugins.description: Blocks gh pr create, merge and ready until a passing self-review verdict covers the exact tree being shipped.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: The pr-self-review workflow: reviews the branch, verifies its findings and writes the verdict sdd-gate checks.
